status: Scratch executor implemented and synthetic guards checked; no native compilation, data generation or measurements; parent review and source-bound smoke still required
source_binding: Modern source, generator/reference files and independent original must match the future corrected accuracy selection lock; historical 52f6212 selection protocol is ineligible.
delta_choice: Reuse globally selected per-core/per-precision/per-policy deltas exactly; no timing-driven retuning.
unavailable: If either core is unavailable within the frozen grid, omit paired timing and report both statuses/reasons. Never substitute a diagnostic delta.
deduplicate: Before execution, group identical (distribution,n,seed,precision,original_delta,modern_delta); attach every policy label and do not count shared timings as independent results.

merge.construction: Frozen generator shuffle and round-robin layout

query_measurement.cdf_probes: Type-7 x at effective q=.1,.5,.9, cycled equally; cast x to selected mean precision

operation_order.block2: reverse of block1, omitting unsupported operations; canonical validation states prebuilt outside timing

query_error_reference: Same post-cast inputs, effective probability rounding, 1003-point quantile grid and fixed empirical/atom/adjacent/gap CDF probes as corrected accuracy protocol
correctness: Require input/query/leaf/state fingerprints and repeated same-core output bits to agree across samples/blocks; modern invariants and wire parity must pass, inherited original quirks retained.
native_profile: One immutable release binary linking both cores under the same modern crate allocator/dependency graph; identical executable for both core modes.
timing_budget_includes: All full-run process generation/reference/state verification and warmup/timed work after build/preflight; timeout uses remaining global budget.

smoke.policy_delta_coverage: All selected distinct parameters across 3 distributions and 2 precisions, both cores; no timing claims.

stopped_run: Preserve logs and partial raw results, label incomplete, never resume silently or alter repetitions.
new_hypothesis: At independently training-selected logical storage or rank policies, does a speed difference persist on fresh input, and what accuracy/state-size tradeoff accompanies it?
reporting_limits: Descriptive ratios with both counterbalanced blocks and per-core drift controls
No world-best, statistical significance, guaranteed equal error, equal capacity/RSS, peak memory, full-platform, Python-adapter or allocator-generalization claim
Modern k-way compared with original sequential is a different route, explicitly labeled
